RocksDB-backed backtest accessors for alignment, init, root slots, shreds, and bank hashes.

# Purpose
This header declares the public interface for a backtest database wrapper around RocksDB. It defines the opaque type `fd_backtest_rocksdb_t` and the `FD_BACKTEST_ROCKSDB_MAGIC` value used to identify the object in shared memory. The function set provides object setup and access helpers, including [`fd_backtest_rocksdb_align`](<#fd_backtest_rocksdb_align>), [`fd_backtest_rocksdb_footprint`](<#fd_backtest_rocksdb_footprint>), [`fd_backtest_rocksdb_new`](<#fd_backtest_rocksdb_new>), [`fd_backtest_rocksdb_join`](<#fd_backtest_rocksdb_join>), and [`fd_backtest_rocksdb_init`](<#fd_backtest_rocksdb_init>). It also declares query functions to read backtest data by slot, such as [`fd_backtest_rocksdb_next_root_slot`](<#fd_backtest_rocksdb_next_root_slot>), [`fd_backtest_rocksdb_shred`](<#fd_backtest_rocksdb_shred>), and [`fd_backtest_rocksdb_bank_hash`](<#fd_backtest_rocksdb_bank_hash>).
